name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover rain flood damage?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover rain flood damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance policies typically cover sudden and accidental water damage, which can include rain entering through a damaged roof or broken window. However, most standard policies do not cover flood damage caused by external factors like rising rivers, storm surges, or overflowing bodies of water. For those, a separate flood insurance policy (often through the NFIP) is required. It is essential to review your specific policy or contact your insurance provider to understand your coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard homeowner's insurance often covers rain damage from a damaged roof, but usually not flood damage from external sources; check your policy for specifics.
